{{Top|leg}}
'''Badge-comms''' were a specialized model of [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] issued to [[Police officer/Legends|Protectors]] operating in the town of [[Corestrike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. The badge-comm also acted as the Protector's badge of office, and could communicate with other Protectors. The comms used a shifting frequency which made them difficult to monitor or jam.<ref name="HNNA">{{JournalCite|12|Heroes Need Not Apply}}</ref>
